title: タイ・インドネシア合同 – 日系企業向けBCセミナー:『海外拠点の“見えないコスト”をどう改善するか？』 ～ Business Centralと最新AI機能で実現する業務最適化 と 経営基盤強化～
summary: Announcement of a free Zoom webinar in Japanese on June 9, 2026, run by AI Network Solution with JBS. It is aimed at Japanese companies with sites in Thailand and Indonesia and covers how Business Central and its newest AI features can make overseas data visible and standardize operations. The agenda covers a BC overview, overseas case studies, a live demo, BC with AI, and Q&A.
key_points: Scattered systems at overseas sites make it hard to see business status in real time
Business Central is presented as a way to make data visible and standardize work across several sites
The agenda covers a BC overview, overseas use cases, an operations demo and the latest AI features
The webinar is free on Zoom, June 9, 2026, aimed at companies considering ERP adoption or a review of core systems
